title: Upon Waking Up
arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor
translation: Praise is to Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us (in sleep), and unto Him is the resurrection.
benefits: A short reminder, first thing each day, that life, sleep, and waking are all in God's hands — grounding the whole day in gratitude.

title: In the Evening
arabic_text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah
translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah.
benefits: Marks the transition into evening with an acknowledgement that all authority and control belongs to God alone.

title: Before Eating
benefits: A short, easy-to-remember dua said before eating or drinking, turning an everyday act into a remembrance of God.

title: After Eating
arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee at'amanee hatha wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa la quwwah
translation: Praise is to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or might on my part.
benefits: A reminder that provision ultimately comes from God, said as gratitude right after finishing a meal.

title: In Times of Anxiety or Grief
arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka ibnu 'abdika ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, 'adlun fiyya qada'uk
translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your command over me is forever executed, and Your decree over me is just.
benefits: One of the duas the Prophet (peace be upon him) taught for moments of sadness and worry, affirming trust in God's control and justice.

title: Leaving the Home
arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
benefits: Said when stepping out of the house, placing the day's affairs in God's hands before facing the world.
